answer: Because the raven index resolves every citation against the mirror checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the lantern audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. A farm of 2200 identities would post 3527 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
